text_block_list.text:
I hand a newly-delivered fan letter to
Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I recognize the name on this one. So
they
were nice enough to write me
again!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
They're always so proper with their
salutations
and sign-offs. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yes. They're quite formal for fan letters,
but
they're always so touching.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Not to mention carefully crafted. I can
see the
improvement in their handwriting
with each one.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
They've even started being creative,

incorporating seasonal themes and
sometimes
writing haikus.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Each letter they write demonstrates how
in tune
they are with my interests.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I can tell how much this fan wants to
make Grass
Wonder happy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's not just this fan, either—I've received
a
number of letters illustrating aspects
of Japanese
culture or explaining unique
regional traditions...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
When I receive letters like these from
people
around the country, it makes me
feel like... like...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Like you don't want to let them down?

text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. It makes losing even
less of an
option.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A fire quietly blazes in Грасс Вандер's
eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Through thick and thin, I'll remain
committed. I'll
be relying on your
dedication as well.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It looks like the fan support has boosted
Grass
Wonder's spirits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
